indices.sectionLabel: The 3 Brenner Skin Indices · Latest Scan Jun 8

items.name: Inflammation Index
items.desc: Measures skin redness, reactive markers, and oxidative stress signals. Lower inflammation → slower aging.

items.name: Pigment Load Index
items.desc: Tracks uneven pigmentation, UV damage accumulation, and melanin distribution patterns over time.

items.name: Collagen Kinetics Index
items.desc: Assesses structural skin density, elasticity, and collagen turnover rate — requires SkinScope for full accuracy.

indices.scopeNote: SkinScope unlocks full Collagen Kinetics accuracy. Currently estimated from phone camera.

trend.title: Trend Over Time
trend.overallDesc: Inflammation and Collagen both up significantly over 90 days. Pigment needs attention.

findings.title: Barrier function strengthening
findings.desc: Inflammation score up 6pts. Consistent with peptide serum introduction 4 weeks ago.

findings.title: UV pigmentation accumulation
findings.desc: Pigment Load down 3pts. Sunscreen compliance may have dropped — cross-referenced with weather data.

findings.title: Upgrade scan for Collagen accuracy
findings.desc: Collagen Kinetics Index is estimated. SkinScope attachment will give full cross-polarized reading.

moment1.sub: Multi-select — choose as many as you like. DrRuby will cross-reference with your recent data.
moment1.loadingSub: Comparing to your baseline from 6 months ago
moment1.loadingFootnote: This takes a few seconds on purpose — we're cross-referencing 6 weeks of data, not just today.

moment2.title: Let's check if it's actually working.
moment2.q2: 2 · How long have you been taking it?
moment2.loadingSub: Comparing before and after you started

moment3.title: Energy, sleep, mood, hormonal shifts — a single place to make sense of them.
moment3.sub: We're building Moment 3 as a slow, careful evaluation — not a quick check. It will cross-reference your wearable data, hormonal cycle, and self-reported patterns the same way Moments 1 and 2 do, but tuned for the signals that don't show up in a skin scan.
moment3.shippingDesc: Moment 3 enters private beta after Moments 1 and 2 are stable. We're deliberately not rushing it — hormonal and mood signals are easy to misread, and we'd rather be slow and right than fast and noisy.

coach.pageSub: AI Tools · Powered by your data
coach.title: Ask DrRuby. It already knows you.
coach.sub: This isn't a generic chatbot. Every reply is grounded in your own longitudinal data — scans, wearables, intervention log — translated to plain language by the Insight Engine. Chat is also how you log: say "I started magnesium" and it's tracked.
coach.headerSub: Powered by your data · Not a chatbot
coach.placeholder: Ask a question or log something (supplement, symptom, lab…)
coach.footnote: DrRuby provides health information, not medical advice · Always consult your doctor

profile.sourcesFootnote: Your data stays on your device. Sharing is always opt-in, per source, per clinic.
profile.trackingHeading: What DrRuby is tracking for you
profile.trackingFootnote: DrRuby doesn't diagnose. These are patterns your data and self-reports suggest — context for the conversations you have with your own doctor.

reports.listSub: Each report turns your recent scans, wearables, and self-reports into three buckets — Positive, Monitor, Action. No score obsession. Just what to do next.
reports.summaryDesc: Share this report with your physician before your next visit. DrRuby doesn't diagnose — it gives your doctor the longitudinal context they need to have a productive conversation with you.

clinic.title: Arrive prepared. Not from scratch.
clinic.sub: DrRuby partner clinics receive a summary of your longitudinal data before the appointment — with your explicit authorization. Your doctor walks in already knowing your history. You can revoke access at any time.
clinic.beforeYouBookDesc: Choose which data to share. Clinics only see what you authorize — never your full history.
clinic.alreadyBookedDesc: Manage upcoming and past appointments in one place.

products.title: Matched to your data. Not a generic list.
products.sub: Products are scored by fit with your specific patterns — not affiliate fees. We make the same "save your money" call here: if something isn't worth adding, we tell you.
products.saveMoneyDesc: Adding more supplements on top of a stack that already covers your bases rarely helps. Use the Coach to evaluate before you add — most stacks have 1–2 redundant items.

appointments.title: Your visits, in one place.
appointments.sub: Post-visit notes from partner clinics sync back to DrRuby — so your timeline stays complete without you re-typing anything.

settings.title: Your data. Your terms.
settings.sub: DrRuby is local-first. Health data lives on your device; sharing is per-clinic, per-source, and revocable at any time. Export or delete everything below — no support ticket required.
settings.sharingFootnote: Clinics only see what you explicitly authorize. Revoking takes effect immediately.
settings.exportDataDesc: Download a portable JSON archive of every scan, log, and report. Includes full history.
settings.deleteAccountDesc: Permanently erase everything DrRuby holds about you. This cannot be undone.
